title: Runbook: customer_id null handling
content: Upstream customer ingestion pipeline degraded. Check source system completeness for customer_id, validate joins to customer_360_view, compare current null_rate to baseline, reprocess affected records if appropriate. Notify data producer.

title: Runbook: order_value removed (rename to order_amount)
content: Schema evolution: order_value removed, order_amount added. Likely rename. Map order_amount to order_value in staging layer (revenue_model), apply casting if type changed, notify downstream Executive Revenue Dashboard consumers. Historical: 2 prior healthy scans suggest recent upstream change.

title: Runbook: Negative amount anomaly
content: Financial column amount contains negative values. Check upstream pricing feed for refunds vs data error. Validate range contract (amount >=0). Quarantine records with amount <0 and alert source system maintainers.

title: Runbook: discount type FLOAT→STRING
content: Datatype regression: discount FLOAT → STRING (e.g., '5%' vs 0.05). Apply casting transformation: strip '%' and divide by 100. Update downstream margin_analysis_model. Check source export format change.

title: Runbook: High null rate
content: High null rate detected. Investigate source completeness, check ingestion logs for dropped records, compare row_count drift, and validate contracts. Consider backfill if historical null_rate is stable.

title: Runbook: Row count drop
content: Row count dropped significantly. Check upstream job run logs for partial failure, verify source row count, check for filtered records due to quality checks. Impact: downstream revenue underreported.

title: Dataset: orders documentation
content: Orders fact table: order_id (PK, entity), customer_id (FK to customers), order_value (revenue), discount (FLOAT), order_date (DATE). Downstream: revenue_model, monthly_revenue, customer_ltv, Executive Revenue Dashboard. Owner: data-eng@dataguard. SLA: <1% null on customer_id, 100% unique order_id.

title: Business: Revenue reporting
content: Revenue reporting KPI: Executive Revenue Dashboard, monthly_revenue, customer LTV. Degraded order_value directly impacts finance close and executive decisions. Escalate to finance-data-oncall if CRITICAL.
